build_SpatialPriorModule: build a SpatialPriorModule to extract multi-scale CNN features from an input image tensor
create_InteractionBlock: create an InteractionBlock that injects image features into tokens and extracts updated context features
create_InteractionBlockWithCls: create an InteractionBlockWithCls that processes tokens with a cls token alongside image feature injection
build_Extractor: build an Extractor module with MSDeformAttn and ConvFFN to extract features from multi-scale spatial inputs
build_Injector: build an Injector module with MSDeformAttn to inject multi-scale image features into query tokens
